messages:
maria_finance: Heads up — Helion Analytics flagged that their Dedicated cluster was double-billed for Feb. They uploaded the invoice and are asking for a one-time credit + short-term payment terms. Can finance approve a special credit?
aj_sales: Oof, Helion is a strategic account but their volume is ramping. What amount are they asking for?
mar ia_finance: They requested a $12,500 credit for the duplicate charge (invoice 2026-00237) and asked to move to Net60 for the next invoice while they reconcile internal PO timing.
billing-bot: Invoice 2026-00237 retrieved — charge lines: 
```
Charge: Redwood Dedicated - 8 GPUs x 720h = $48,000
Duplicate charge detected: 1x identical line; duplicate amount = $12,000
Tax & adjustments = $500
Total due: $60,500
```
kevin_revops: Quick note — distrib of credits impacts MRR recognition and could trigger a commission claw if >$10k. We should keep credits <= $10k to avoid manual comp ops unless sales agrees.
aj_sales: Can we do $7,500 credit + waive late fees and offer Net45 for next 2 invoices? Sales will absorb some margin but keeps renewal healthy.
tom_legal: Fine with a one-time goodwill credit, but legal needs language: "one-time credit, not a precedent for future billing disputes" + customer must sign confirmation email acknowledging resolution. Also confirm no SLA change.
sarah_finance_director: I can approve up to $10k. If the team is willing to accept $7,500 as compromise, I approve the credit and Net45 for 90 days. Any commission/comp exceptions must be logged and approved by comp ops.
maria_finance: OK — proposal: $7,500 credit applied to invoice 2026-00237, add Net45 for next 2 invoices, customer to acknowledge in email. I'll prepare the credit memo.
aj_sales: I'll confirm with Helion and ask them to send an acknowledgement email. If they push harder, escalate back here. :thumbsup:
kevin_revops: Please add an entry in Deal Desk: Helion Analytics — credit $7.5k, reason: duplicate billing; comp ops ticket #CO-3897 created for tracking.
maria_finance: Created credit memo CM-2026-045 and queueing for apply on 2026-03-01. Adding note to customer record.
tom_legal: I'll draft the acknowledgement wording and paste here for Aj to send.
maria_finance: tagging billing-bot to apply credit once we have customer ack.
billing-bot: Action queued: apply CM-2026-045 after receipt of customer_ack_helion_2026-03-01.eml.
sarah_finance_director: Approved (internal): $7,500 credit + Net45 x2 invoices. Document the decision in Deal Desk and attach the customer ack.
maria_finance: Thanks all — closing this thread once ack received.
